title: Our Wonderful Days
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: In rural Japan, high-school first-year Koharu is reunited with Mafuyu, a childhood friend who has moved back from Tokyo. The three-volume story follows small everyday moments (convenience stores, homework, clubs) with friends Minori and Nanaya as Koharu's friendship with Mafuyu grows into a crush.
life_message: A good life is found in small shared joys and close friendships that can deepen into love.

content.note: Schoolgirl crush between friends; Yuri tag (AniList, Wikipedia).
Began as a Pixiv web comic; no merchandising focus noted.

folkways.japan: The rural-versus-Tokyo contrast and the seasonal school calendar reflect common Japanese settings; the story's restraint about feelings fits norms of indirect expression.
